scenes.narration: Small businesses need posts every week, but most owners have no designer and little time. Over half get an hour or less a day for marketing.

card.title: Posts every week. No designer. No time.
card.subtitle: Small shops and cafés need regular, truthful posts.
bullets: Only 13% of Indian MSMEs use social media marketing
56% of small businesses have an hour or less a day for marketing
Generic AI tools can put a wrong price or a garbled word on a post
card.footnote: Sources: SIDBI report via Entrepreneur India (2025); Constant Contact survey of 1,300+ small businesses in the US, UK, Australia and Canada (2024).

scenes.narration: Gemini writes the words once, and the Design Studio opens with five starting designs, every word, logo and contact drawn by code, not an image model.
The owner picks one, tries another font pair, and can edit any word, redrawn live. Use this design draws every size and checks the words again.
In Review, the owner adds free home delivery across Pune to the caption. That is not in the brief, so the fact check, code plus Gemini, flags it. The owner removes it and approves.

scenes.narration: On the Queue, the card is live. When the time has passed, Cloud Scheduler calls our Cloud Run service, which emails the post to the owner, and Firestore pushes the new status here, no reload.
Firestore rules mirror our database security: a one-hour custom token lets a browser read only its own brand's status, and never write.

card.title: Read your own brand. Never write.
card.subtitle: Cloud Run mints a Firebase Auth custom token with claims { b: brandId, until }, valid 60 minutes, without a key file.
bullets: match /brands/{brandId}/live/{docId} {
allow get, list: if request.auth.token.b == brandId
&& request.time.toMillis() < request.auth.token.until;
allow create, update, delete: if false;
card.footnote: firestore.rules (abridged). Status only: no captions, emails or payment IDs.

scenes.narration: Under the hood: one Next.js app on Cloud Run. Gemini on Vertex AI drafts, fact-checks, and grounds Ideas in Google Search. Supabase Postgres with row-level security holds the data.

card.title: Built on Google Cloud
card.subtitle: One Next.js app on Cloud Run (australia-southeast1)
bullets: Cloud Run serves the app; Cloud Scheduler runs the queue sweep and weekly jobs
Gemini on Vertex AI: brief from plain words, captions, fact check, grounded Ideas with Google Search
Firestore live status: Firebase Auth custom tokens, read-only brand-scoped rules
Supabase Postgres with row-level security: the system of record
Code draws every word, logo and QR (HarfBuzz + resvg); no text inside AI images
card.footnote: Firestore holds only short-lived status: never captions, emails or payment IDs.
